ValidationRule.description: To restrict the length to less than 100 characters
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Billing_Street__c)), OR( LEN(Billing_Street__c) > 100, REGEX(Billing_Street__c, '(.*\r?\n.*)*'), REGEX(Billing_Street__c, '.*\\s{2,}+.*') ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Billing Street must not contain line breaks, or double white spaces and must be 100 characters or less
